correctness.rationale: The deficiency identity, base-p digit argument, binary uniqueness converse, endpoint cases, and low-k corollaries were rederived. Exact subset-sum verification on 672 bounded parameter triples found 92 qualifying cases, each with one representation, and zero mismatches.

originality.rationale: Tang--Ren--Li's two-prime deficient-perfect classification, Chen's odd exactly-2 classification, Aursukaree--Pongsriiam's odd exactly-3 classification, current OEIS entries, synonymous searches, and the SCOPE archive were checked. No arbitrary-k even two-prime classification or equivalent binary/base-p uniqueness theorem was located; originality is to the best of our knowledge with explicit hidden-prior-art risk.

value.rationale: The theorem completely classifies a natural infinite two-prime-support slice for every k, proves uniqueness of the deficient-divisor set, recovers the known k=1 family, yields full even k=2 and k=3 slices, and gives existence for every exponent pair.
